parts.label: (b)
(b)(i)
parts.part_stem: The electric field is produced by applying a potential difference of $4.0\text{ kV}$ between two charged parallel metal plates.

parts.text: Calculate the separation between the plates.
Describe the arrangement of the two plates. Include in your answer a statement of the sign of the charge on each plate. You may draw on Fig. 4.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude and direction of the force on sphere $Y$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
The electric forces acting on the two spheres form a couple. This couple acts on the rod with a torque of $6.2 \times 10^{-16}\text{ N m}$.

Calculate the angle $\theta$ of the rod to the horizontal.
